pages.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.
997
12/3/17
March 13th 1917.

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
On the day before the telegram of Tang
Shao Yi 唐紹儀 and Wen Tsung Yao 溫宗堯
was forwarded to the Senate and the House
of Representatives in Peking, Tang Shao Yi
called at the house of Sun Yat Sen
on the Route Vallon.

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

13/3
Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
上海工部局。
997
12/3/17
1917年3月13日。

警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：
在唐绍仪与温宗尧致北京参议院和众议院的电报发出前一天，唐绍仪曾前往位于法隆路（Route Vallon）的孙中山寓所拜访。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

13/3
警察总监
